title: Mayo Clinic Radiotherapy Patient Outcomes Registry and Biobanking Study
official: Mayo Clinic Radiotherapy Patient Outcomes Registry and Biobanking Study
summary: To collect and analyze specimens that will correlate with clinical outcomes such as acute and late toxicities, quality of life, local control, and survival of patients treated with photon/proton therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Treated with photon/proton at Mayo Clinic Rochester in Radiation Oncology
2. Radiation therapy for curative intent

Exclusion Criteria:

None
